title: Expected number of visits
statement: Let $G$ be a regular multigraph of degree $D$ on a vertex type $V$. For vertices $v,u\in V$ and an integer $N\ge 0$, the expected number of visits to $v$ in an $N$-step walk from $u$ is the sum of the visit counts over all sequences of $N$ indices in $\mathrm{Fin}(D)$, divided by $D^N$.
hypotheses_covered: A regular multigraph on V of natural-number degree D
Vertices v and u in V
